edits.original: Field crews still collect vouchers, make no mistake.
edits.reason: Negative-clause windup that adds nothing checkable to the surrounding claim about herbarium sheets and field collections.

edits.original: Herbarium staff still mark sterile Carex sheets as undetermined… until a fruiting collection arrives.
edits.reason: Standalone narrative aside whose only content is already implied by the scientific point about identifying Carex via fruiting material.

edits.original: A robust regression of leaf mass on area down-weights herbivore-damaged outliers in allometric studies.
edits.reason: Standalone methodological aside that introduces a fact with no payoff or callback in the surrounding discussion of the cell wall.

edits.original: A standard pectin assay ran in 40 minutes before the protocol change and in 6 minutes after it, so the change significantly streamlines cell-wall composition analysis.
edits.reason: Standalone quantitative anecdote that interrupts the cell-wall description and never resurfaces to support an argument.

edits.original: Rubisco is the only carboxylase in the Calvin-Benson cycle, full stop.
edits.reason: Padded restatement of 'full stop' that adds no information beyond the clause it emphatically repeats.

edits.original: Researchers divide carbon-concentrating mechanisms into a spatial regime, where mesophyll and bundle-sheath cells share the work, and a temporal regime, where stomata open at night, close to the C4-versus-CAM split, spatial packing is the C4 case, temporal packing is the CAM one.
edits.replacement: Researchers divide carbon-concentrating mechanisms into a spatial regime, where mesophyll and bundle-sheath cells share the work (C4), and a temporal regime, where stomata open at night (CAM).
edits.reason: Definition doubling that introduces the spatial/temporal distinction and then restates it twice more through the C4/CAM analogy without adding any new fact.

edits.original: The seedlings bolted in week 3 they never formed heads—the market rejected the entire lot.
edits.reason: Orphan narrative aside on the topic of bolting and head formation that is abandoned mid-sentence and never connected to anything else in the paragraph on classification.

edits.original: Conservation collections still accession landraces, rather than heirlooms.
edits.reason: Negative-clause restatement that adds no new information and sits isolated amid the discussion of phylogenetic insight.

edits.original: Breeders select dwarfing alleles on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.reason: Padded negation and restatement ('on purpose, rather than by accident') that contributes no information to the Green Revolution passage.

edits.original: Yield loss fell from 41 percent in rainfed plots to 8 percent with irrigation, so supplemental irrigation dramatically reduces yield loss in dry years.
edits.reason: Standalone quantitative aside on irrigation that interrupts the point about narrowing the genetic base and never returns to support an argument.

edits.original: Morphine is not synthesized by the Pacific yew; it is produced in Papaver somniferum latex.
edits.replacement: Morphine comes from Papaver somniferum latex.
edits.reason: Padded negation and restatement: the negative half ('not synthesized by the Pacific yew') is a windup since the yew was just not listed as a morphine source, so the positive half alone states the claim.

edits.original: The construct was designed for chloroplast transformation, not nuclear transformation.
edits.replacement: The construct was designed for chloroplast transformation.
edits.reason: Negative-clause windup whose negated alternative ('not nuclear transformation') adds no information, since nuclear transformation was never in play at that point in the discussion.

edits.original: Botany, far from being a static catalog of flora, is a dynamic, integrative science that underpins food security, health, climate mitigation, and cultural identity.
edits.replacement: Botany is a dynamic, integrative science that underpins food security, health, climate mitigation, and cultural identity.
edits.reason: Negative-clause windup ('far from being a static catalog of flora') that restates the positive claim already made, adding nothing checkable.

edits.original: a deep, nuanced understanding of plant biology is not optional; it is imperative.
edits.replacement: a deep, nuanced understanding of plant biology is imperative.
edits.reason: Negative-clause windup ('not optional') whose positive half ('it is imperative') already carries the full claim; deleting the negative half loses nothing.
